headlines.description: — Lars Eller broke a third-period tie and the Ottawa Senators prevented Buffalo from wrapping up a drought-breaking playoff spot Thursday night, beating the Sabres 4-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators delay the Sabres' bid to clinch drought-breaking playoff spot

events.name: Pittsburgh Penguins at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Anthony Cirelli registered his second career hat trick, Nikita Kucherov had a goal and three points, and the Tampa Bay Lightning moved into first place in the Atlantic Division after a 6-3 victory against the Pittsburgh Penguins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cirelli gets 2nd career hat trick and Lightning move into 1st in Atlantic after beating Penguins 6-3

headlines.description: — Florida goaltender Sergei Bobrovsky made 15 saves in the third period and 28 overall as the Panthers defeated the Boston Bruins 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Two-time Stanley Cup champion Panthers avoid playoff elimination with 2-1 win over Bruins

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored his 48th and 49th goals of the season, and the Montreal Canadiens won their seventh game in a row to move closer to making the playoffs by defeating the New York Rangers 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Caufield reaches 49 goals as the Canadiens win their 7th in a row by beating the Rangers

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Patrick Kane scored a pivotal goal in the same building where he scored a Stanley Cup Final winner, Alex DeBrincat scored two goals and Lucas Raymond had one to lead the Detroit Red Wings past the Philadelphia Flyers 4-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane scores pivotal goal as Red Wings beat Flyers 4-2 in a playoff-race swing

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Logan Stankoven scored two goals in the first nine minutes, and the Carolina Hurricanes clinched a playoff berth for the eighth season in a row by beating the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stankoven scores twice as Hurricanes beat Blue Jackets 5-1, clinch playoff berth

events.name: Washington Capitals at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Jack Hughes had two goals and three assists and Dawson Mercer scored twice as the New Jersey Devils beat the Washington Capitals 7-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jack Hughes' 5-point game powers the Devils to a 7-3 win over the Capitals

headlines.description: — Jake Oettinger made 22 saves for his third shutout of the season in a matchup of Team USA Olympic goaltenders and rookie Arttu Hyry had a goal in his first multipoint NHL game as the Dallas Stars beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Oettinger beats Connor Hellebuyck in matchup of Team USA goaltenders as Stars blank Jets 3-0

headlines.description: — Matt Boldy scored his 39th and 40th goals, Kirill Kaprizov added his 40th and the Minnesota Wild wrapped up a playoff spot with a 5-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild wrap up a playoff spot with 5-2 victory over the Canucks

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid set up Matt Savoie's power-play goal to pad his NHL-leading points total and help the Edmonton Oilers win their season-high fifth straight game, 3-1 over the Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers win season-high 5th straight, beating Chicago 3-1 to end Blackhawks' playoff hopes

events.name: Calgary Flames at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Mitch Marner had three goals and two assists and the Golden Knights scored three times in the third period to defeat the Calgary Flames 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marner has 5 points and Golden Knights score 3 times in 3rd period to beat Flames 6-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Zack Ostapchuk scored his first goal in nearly three months and the San Jose Sharks beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-1 on Thursday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks win 4th straight to improve playoff hopes, beating the Maple Leafs 4-1

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley scored twice for the first of Utah's six straight goals, Karel Vejmelka made 25 saves and Mammoth beat the Seattle Kraken 6-2 on Thursday night for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooley scores twice in the Mammoth's 6-2 victory over the Kraken

events.name: Nashville Predators at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Luke Evangelista scored the only goal of the shootout in the eighth round, and the Nashville Predators tightened the Western Conference playoff race with a 5-4 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luke Evangelista ends shootout in 8th round, Predators tighten playoff race with 5-4 win over Kings
